desc:
Try to survive the zombie apocalypse as long as possible. The game is inspired by COD Zombie.

Follow the game owner, join the community and like the game to earn bonuses!
Enable notifications to stay updated!

Premium benefits are available! Extra weapons and health at the start!

[MOBILE SUPPORT]
The shot is fired automatically, you just need to aim at the zombies.

[PC]
Chat - [ / ]
Lock / Unlock mouse - [F4] 
KEYBOARD Movement - [W][S][A][D] 
Interaction (Hold) - [F] 
Aim - [Right Mouse Button] 
Reload - [R] 
Change Weapon - [1][2] 
Sprint (Hold) - [Left Shift] 

[GAMEPAD] 
[X] - Activate, [A] - Jump, [Y] - Reload 
[L1] - Aim, [L2] - Weapon, [R1] - Fire, [R2] - Run

Tags: Zombie, Zombies, COD, Survival, Apocalypse, Invasion, Horror, Dead
